entries.statement: Captured metadata/schema responses do not constitute immutable row acquisition or handling authority.

entries.statement: Independent exact-byte narrow probes establish 681 current rows, 375 distinct licence numbers, and one witness licence with 175 distinct raw addresses; licence or brand therefore cannot identify a physical location.
entries.decision_effect: Require address-bearing, resource-scoped location candidates and empirical adjudication.

entries.statement: Resource membership and modification clocks are distinct from application event clocks.
Current annual resources do not prove what bytes were public at historical prediction dates.
entries.decision_effect: Exclude from point-in-time features until dated archives are verified.

entries.statement: Independent exact-byte captures show materially non-equivalent cross-partition records for normalized SYS_ID 3209741.
entries.decision_effect: Retain resource-scoped rows and require adjudication.

entries.statement: Repository policy, not retrieved public content, controls credentials, spend, handling, and live use.
